rules.title: Invalid JSON-LD
rules.description: A JSON-LD block failed to parse. Search engines ignore invalid structured data.
rules.fix: Fix the JSON syntax (trailing commas, unescaped quotes, HTML entities).
rules.verify: Validate with the Rich Results Test or Schema Markup Validator.

rules.title: JSON-LD without @context
rules.description: A JSON-LD block has no @context (e.g. "https://schema.org"), so types cannot be resolved.

rules.title: Structured data missing properties required for rich results
rules.description: Markup for a rich-result type lacks properties that Google lists as required, making the item ineligible for that rich result.
rules.fix: Add the required properties with values that match visible page content.
rules.verify: Validate with the Rich Results Test.

rules.title: Markup for a retired rich result type
rules.description: The page uses a type whose Google rich result has been retired (e.g. HowTo, FAQPage since 2026-05, ClaimReview, CourseInfo, SpecialAnnouncement, VehicleListing). The markup is harmless but produces no rich result in Google Search.
rules.fix: No action required. Keep the markup only if other consumers use it.

sources.title: Google: Changes to HowTo and FAQ rich results (2023)
Google: Simplifying the search results page (2025)

rules.title: No structured data
rules.description: No JSON-LD, Microdata or RDFa detected. Structured data is optional but enables rich results and helps engines understand entities.
rules.fix: Add JSON-LD for types that describe the page (Organization, Product, Article, BreadcrumbList, …) using only visible facts.
rules.verify: Validate with the Rich Results Test.

rules.title: No Organization structured data on the homepage
rules.description: The homepage has no Organization markup. Google uses Organization structured data for logo and organisation details; consistent entity data helps search and AI systems identify the brand.
rules.fix: Add Organization JSON-LD (name, url, logo, sameAs) on the homepage.
rules.verify: Validate with the Rich Results Test.
